sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description: Creates a new environmental pollution complaint record in ServiceNow after the citizen confirms the complaint details. Use this tool only after collecting the required complaint information, translating it into English, and receiving confirmation from the citizen. Preserve the original-language transcript and the English complaint details when the configured fields are available.
